propertyTaxRate.note: Tax Foundation 'Property Taxes by State' table (Mar 2026): Nevada 0.50% for 2024 (0.51% for 2023), total real taxes paid / total owner-occupied value (ACS B25082, B25090). File value 0.53% is 0.03 pp above, within tolerance.

programs.name: Wartime Veteran's Property Tax Exemption

exemptionValue.quote: VETERAN ... 2026-27 EXEMPTION 3,640 (assessed value; CPI adjustment 1.82 on $2,000 base)

wartimeRequired.quote: NRS 361.090 wartime veterans exemption, $2,000 base, CPI-indexed; 90+ continuous days of active duty in a listed period or campaign medal

survivingSpouse.quote: The wartime veteran exemption (361.090) does not pass to a surviving spouse; NRS 361.080 is the separate, non-veteran surviving-spouse exemption ($1,820 FY2026-27)

programs.effectiveChanges: FY2027-28 (from July 1, 2027): $3,760 assessed (CPI adjustment 1.88), about $10,743 market-equivalent at the 35% ratio. Department of Taxation schedule dated Sept 25, 2026.
programs.note: $3,640 / 0.35 = $10,400 market-equivalent; row is right for FY2026-27 (July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027). Can be applied to the vehicle Governmental Services Tax instead; any GST use reduces the property exemption (NRS 361.1565).

programs.name: Disabled Veteran's Property Tax Exemption

ratingRequired.quote: NRS 361.091: permanent service-connected disability of 60 percent or more; amount depends on 'the total percentage of permanent service-connected disability'

survivingSpouse.quote: surviving spouse ... married to and living with the veteran for the 5 years preceding death, the veteran was eligible, the spouse has not remarried and is a Nevada resident (NRS 361.091(6))

schedularTiered.quote: the total percentage of permanent service-connected disability

programs.effectiveChanges: FY2027-28 (from July 1, 2027): $18,800 / $28,200 / $37,600 assessed (CPI adjustment 1.88), about $53,714 / $80,571 / $107,429 market-equivalent at the 35% ratio. Department of Taxation FY2027-28 schedule already posted (Sept 25, 2026); swap the row values at the July 1, 2027 refresh.
programs.note: FY2026-27 assessed amounts $18,200 / $27,300 / $36,400 confirmed; market-equivalents $52,000 / $78,000 / $104,000 are exact at 35%. The summary's '5+ years married' should read 'married to and living with the veteran for the 5 years before death'. TDIU note is correct: tier follows combined permanent rating.
